## Decisions and limits per donor

### trycua/cua

- Pin: `a802eaf26ca97616a6bf0de6a29729a9346fbb1f` (2026-10-17)
- Source access: public
- License evidence: LICENSING.md at the pinned commit
- Component license: `libs/cua-driver (all crates)`: MIT
- Component license: `libs/cua (cua-sdk, cua-sandbox-core, cua-vmm, cua-image, cua-daemon, cua-proto, cua-mesh)`: MIT
- Component license: `libs/lume`: MIT
- Component license: `libs/cua-bench, libs/cua-bench-rl, libs/cua-s1/python, libs/cua-bench-s1/python`: MIT
- Component license: `apps/cua-spaces*, libs/cua-spacesd, libs/cua/crates/cua-spaces-*, cua-keyvault, cua-teleport*, cua-machine-seal, cua-volume, cua-media-*, cua-viewer, cua-spacesd-html5, cua-logging, libs/spaces-*-swift`: FSL-1.1-MIT
- Component license: `benchmarks/cua-driver-bench`: FSL-1.1-MIT
- Component license: `libs/python/som`: AGPL-3.0-or-later
- Component license: `libs/cua-driver/rust/crates/cua-perception/models (OmniParser icon detector)`: AGPL-3.0-only (third-party model)
- Strategy (WRAP): Vendor the MIT Cua Driver platform crates at the pin and call their tool implementations in-process from an Orcel-owned private host (macOS, Linux). COPY_ADAPT cua-vmm's Runtime trait and backends for the optional sandbox subsystem. REFERENCE Lume, cua-bench, CUA-S1. REJECT cuabot (upstream marks it unsafe), the Cua MCP/HTTP/daemon surfaces, its CDP browser engine, run_script (QuickJS), Computer History, telemetry, FSL components by architecture (network listeners, separate enrollment and keyvault) even though FD-04 now authorizes their reuse, and the AGPL perception extension.

## Sources named but not inventoried

- **BrowserSafe.** Named in the founder directive; no repository URL, commit or license appears in any Orcel record or local checkout. Not inventoried until the founder supplies the source.
- **OpenCLI.** No OpenCLI repository is pinned in any Orcel record. The only occurrence found is Agent-Reach's agent_reach/channels/_opencli_site.py, which routes 'browser-session-only platforms' to an external 'opencli' executable that relies on the user's logged-in browser sessions. That pattern uses personal sessions outside Orcel's browser confinement and is REJECT as an execution path; no source is inventoried.
- **Exa, Tavily, Serper, ScrapingBee, Brave Search.** Hosted search/scrape services. No donor source to reuse; at most optional user-credentialed adapters behind the network policy. Never mandatory (no mandatory paid API).
- **SearXNG.** Self-hostable metasearch (AGPL-3.0 upstream). Consumed only over its HTTP API by an optional adapter; no source copied, so its license does not reach Orcel code.
- **PStack, Graft, TesterArmy E2E, Local D1, Jev.** Engineering review/test tools already used by the governance pathway; not product donors.
- **Private donors recorded in SOURCE_REUSE_MATRIX.md 'Private donor provenance'.** Kept local to the founder by the earlier review; not visible in this environment.
